name: price-quote-card
title: Price quote card
description: A price quote you received: number, validity, total with tax stated and its status, with accept and decline of equal weight, download and a way back when it expires.
docs: number, issuedAt, validUntil, total (in the currency's own minor units: 1452000 is 14,520.00 EUR, but 1,452,000 JPY, which has none), currency, taxIncluded (the rate in percent that the total includes: 21 says '21% VAT included', and labels.taxName renames the tax), status, supplier ({ name, contact? } or a string) and summary. validUntil is a date-only string (valid through the end of that day in timeZone) or a date-time, and the card says 'Valid until 30 Nov, 12 days left'. Pass now from the server for a first render that already counts the days; without it the card writes the plain date until the browser's clock is known. With now, the card's clock starts there, so a decision made in the card is stamped with now plus the time since it was given (a preview with a fixed now reads in its own time). An open quote (sent, viewed) past its date is shown as expired. Accept and decline are equal buttons that each ask once in a popover that keeps a gutter from the screen's edge on a phone (labels.cancel is its cancel button); onAccept and onDecline may return a promise (the popover shows the busy state, and if it rejects nothing is recorded and the card says so). Afterwards the card shows the outcome and when (decidedAt, or the moment of the click) and moves the keyboard focus to that line, because the buttons that held it are gone; a status that arrives from the page does not move the focus. An expired quote disables both and shows 'Ask for a new quote' for onRequestNew; onDownload adds 'Download PDF'. locale and timeZone write the dates, and labels holds every fixed word.
